task.name: Strike_sound_system
task.when: During Strike after the Sound Lead closes the final event

step.action: Have the Power Lead de-energize and verify the sound-system power circuit.
Have the Sound Lead disconnect signal and de-energized power connections in the printed sequence.
Inspect each retrieved cable for cuts, exposed wire, damaged plugs, dirt, moisture, or heat marks.
step.ifThen: IF a cable is damaged, THEN separate and mark it out of service.

step.action: Coil each cable in the method shown in 📦 Build_Book.
Pack each speaker, control, antenna, cable, and accessory in its assigned transport container.
Have the Sound Lead count the packed system against the inventory.

passWhen.criterion: The sound system is de-energized and fully disconnected.
Every component and cable is inspected, accounted for, and packed.
Damaged equipment is separated and marked out of service.
The Sound Lead released the empty stage for structural strike.
